summary.plain: The 2015 design document proposing JUNO: a giant underground liquid-scintillator detector in southern China built to find out how neutrino masses are ordered.
summary.technical: arXiv:1508.07166, JUNO Conceptual Design Report (submitted 2015-08-28): describes the proposed 20 kt liquid-scintillator detector 53 km from the Yangjiang and Taishan nuclear power plants, its physics reach for the neutrino mass hierarchy and oscillation parameters, and the detector, calibration, veto and readout subsystems.
